## Command


## Expected behaviour

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behaviour

What actually happened. Include the full terminal output (run with `--verbose` if possible).

## Environment

- petrify version: <!-- petrify --version -->
- Python version: <!-- python --version -->
- OS / arch: <!-- e.g. macOS 15.4 arm64 -->

## Sample clip

If you can share a short clip (even 5–10 seconds) that reproduces the issue, please attach it or link to it. This speeds up diagnosis enormously.

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant.
